title: Seconds to a clock
description:
Turn a number of seconds into hours, minutes and seconds.

```
Seconds: 3725
01:02:05
```
hints: `total / 3600` is the hours; `total % 3600 / 60` the minutes; `total % 60` the seconds (lesson 1.04).
`%02d` pads with a zero to two digits.
requirements: Negative numbers print `Seconds cannot be negative`.
